blocks.text: CEBU CITY — Intelligence operatives and personnel from the Traffic Enforcement Unit (TEU) recovered the sports utility vehicle (SUV) that was involved in a hit-and-run case involving three individuals in Sitio Masiwa, Barangay Marigondon last Sunday night, September 27. Authorities found the SUV in a vacant lot near Vistamar at 4:00 p.m. on Monday, September 28. They had the vehicle towed and brought to the TEU impounding area for safekeeping and further investigation. Authorities successfully traced the registered owner of the vehicle, who is reportedly from Luzon. However, investigators have withheld the owner’s identity pending further verification.
